name: Bjornis
lore: A furnace-line veteran who reads battle through smoke and carries the memory of every crew he failed to pull from a burning breach.

abilities.name: Firebreak Vow
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Grit against red threats and while fighting in Cinder Fields.

abilities.name: Foam and Fury
abilities.text: After you defeat a red threat, reduce scenario pressure by 1 if it is above 0. Weakness: you suffer -1 on blue Anomaly tests.
